text: Ko Allah woni waɗiranɗo on jemma on, niɓɓitirɗo, fii ka deeƴon fowtoɗon e mun, O waɗirani on nyalorma on, ndayginɗo, fii ka gollon e mun. Pellet, Allah ko Jom ɓural mawngal e yimɓe ɓen, tawde O timminirii neemaaji Makko ɗin e maɓɓe, no feeñiri e no wirnori. Kono ko ɓuri ɗuuɗude e yimɓe ɓen, ɓe yettataa Allah, e naamaaji Makko ɗin, dow maɓɓe.
